title: refactor(ci): unify lint/test/release workflows and improve cache hygiene
author: Lena Park
release_notes: Consolidates CI workflows to reduce duplicate runs and improve cache hit rates; bumps selected actions for security/hygiene. No product-facing changes.
description: Context: Over the last 12 months we've accumulated numerous GitHub Actions workflows that run overlapping lint/test steps and duplicate release automation logic. This has increased CI runtime, made cache usage inefficient, and created maintenance burden when bumping Actions or reorganizing job matrices. Motivation: Reduce total CI cost and flakiness by unifying lint/test/release responsibilities into a smaller set of targeted workflows, standardize cache keys and restore strategies across repositories, and bump GH Actions and runners to eliminate known CVEs. This PR implements a conservative refactor that preserves job-level outputs while consolidating orchestration. Summary of changes: - Split lint/test into two consistently-named workflows (ci-lint.yml, ci-test.yml) that can be triggered independently and by pull request. - Consolidated release automation into a single release/workflows/release.yml that reuses the same build/test matrix and removes duplicated steps. - Standardized cache keys across npm/yarn/pyenv jobs and replaced per-branch ephemeral keys with deterministic keys plus branch suffix. - Bumped actions/setup-node, actions/checkout, and cache actions to latest minor versions and added required permissions to reduce token prompts. - Added hygiene jobs to run periodic cache-clean and action-version scans. Checklist: 1) Update workflow names and triggers 2) Verify cache keys and restores 3) Bump actions/deps and run CI 4) Run release automation in dry-run 5) Collect metrics on runtime and cache hit-rate Implementation notes: The refactor keeps job scripts and test commands unchanged; it primarily moves job definitions into fewer workflow files and centralizes reusable composite actions under .github/actions/. Backwards compatibility: Branch protection and required checks were preserved by mapping previous check names to the new workflow job names using the repository settings team. Observability: Added workflow-level step timings and a dashboard link to track pre/post changes. Commits: See commit list below. CI: After initial work, lint jobs had a transient install failure due to registry flakiness; rerun cleared the intermittent error and a subsequent full CI run passed. Release automation was validated in dry-run mode against the release candidate pipeline. Merge: Squash-merged after approvals and a successful CI run. Notes: This is intentionally conservative; future follow-ups will combine matrices across repos where safe and add action pinning.
commits: ci(workflows): add ci-lint.yml and ci-test.yml and move lint/test jobs into dedicated workflows
ci(release): consolidate release steps into release/workflows/release.yml and add dry-run mode
ci(actions): bump actions/checkout@v4 actions/setup-node@v4 actions/cache@v4 and pin minor versions
ci(cache): standardize cache keys for node and python jobs and add cache hygiene job
chore(ci): add workflow-level timing annotations and docs link
docs(ci): update CONTRIBUTING.md with new workflow names and required checks
